target.fail:
Wrong build JDK: Maven is running on Java ${java.version} (${java.home}).
OpenGGF targets Java 21, and CI and the release workflow both build and test on temurin 21. Surefire forks inherit Maven's JVM rather than the `java` on PATH, so on a newer JDK the test suite reports large numbers of phantom failures (Mockito stubbing errors leaking across classes, ROM fixtures failing to load) that have nothing to do with your change.
Fix: point JAVA_HOME at a JDK 21 before building, e.g. export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk-21 # macOS: $(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) Verify with `mvn -v` — it must report "Java version: 21".
To bypass deliberately (not for test runs): -Dopenggf.jdk.check.skip=true
